articles.title: CVE-2026-120432 — CVSS 7.8
articles.summary: Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.02.30, and 11.15.08 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in winicontopam that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via oversized ICO/CUR dimensions. Attackers can supply a crafted icon file with width or height above 32767, wrapping int16_t loop counters into negative row buffer indices to cause crashes or potential code execution.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120431 — CVSS 7.8
articles.summary: Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.29, and 11.03 before 11.15.07 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in sgitopnm's readChannels() function when processing RLE-compressed SGI images. Attackers can supply crafted SGI files with oversized offset table lengths to write controlled data past the heap buffer, causing crashes or potential code execution.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120429 — CVSS 7.1
articles.summary: Camaleon CMS before 2.9.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Admin::MediaController that allows low-privileged authenticated users to bypass the role-based Media permission. Attackers can POST to /admin/media/upload to store files, read private media via download_private_file, and use crop with saved_avatar to change other users' avatars.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120428 — CVSS 6.1
articles.summary: PandaWiki 3.65.0 through 3.87.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload HTML files with image extensions via /share/v1/common/file/upload. Attackers can lure administrators to /static-file/<key>?a=.pdf, bypassing the nginx attachment header to serve HTML inline and steal the panda_wiki_token JWT for session takeover.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120426 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: OpenCSG CSGHub through v2.6.0-ce contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the unauthenticated file resolve route that allows remote attackers to read private repository files. Attackers can inject a percent-encoded current_user parameter into the file path, which the portal forwards with its server API key, to read files in private model, code or space repositories.

articles.title: CVE-2026-113511 — CVSS 9.1
articles.summary:
Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in Apache Syncope.



A delegated administrator can relocate a Realm subtree across administrative realm boundaries without permission for the destination
This issue affects Apache Syncope: from 3.0.0-M0 through 3.0.16, from 4.0.0-M0 through 4.0.8, from 4.1.0-M0 through 4.1.3.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.0.9 / 4.1.

articles.title: CVE-2026-111959 — CVSS 9.1
articles.summary:
Out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Apache Arrow Rust (`arrow` crate), from version 33.0.0 through to versions 57.3.1, 58.4.0, 59.3.1 and 60.0.0.



Improper validation of RunEndEncoded arrays in the ArrayData interface can allow reading data beyond the bounds of the child values array.



Users are recommended to upgrade to versions 60.1.0, 59.3.2, 58.4.1, 57.3.2 which fixes the issue.

articles.title: CVE-2026-110535 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary:
Improper Privilege Management vulnerability in Apache Syncope.



AuthProfile self-updates allow non-admin users to configure impersonation for WA surrogate authentication.
This issue affects Apache Syncope: from 3.0.12 through 3.0.16, from 4.0.0-M0 through 4.0.8, from 4.1.0-M0 through 4.1.3.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.0.9 / 4.1.4, which fix this issue.
